LanguageData.StandardAnimalArmorHuge.label: standard animal armor (huge)
LanguageData.StandardAnimalArmorHuge.description:
Modern animal armor that offers a moderate amount of protection while not compromising mobility owing to lighter construction and a comfortable cloth lining.
Fits on animals with a mature body size of 2.4 or greater.
